patch_description: Replace the final RZ layer with RY rotations while retaining the same parameter count. Final RZ gates commute with Z measurement, so the last block’s eight post-rotation parameters have no effect on predictions and receive zero gradients; analogous gates in earlier blocks also provide only indirect utility. Final RY gates directly rotate phase and correlation information into measurable Z populations, improve gradient flow, and give every parameter copy an observable role. This should improve loss and convergence without increasing circuit size or reducing parameter efficiency.
